s: some people are afraid of trying something new
some people are content with the simple, traditional ways and do not crave for the latest fashions
was der Bauer nicht kennt, das frisst er.et: Calque of German Low German wat de Buur nich kennt, dat frett he nich (“what the farmer doesn’t know, he won’t eat”). Compare also Dutch wat de boer niet kent, dat vreet hij niet.

was du heute kannst besorgen, verschiebe.i: /vas duː ˈhɔɪ̯tə kanst bəˈzɔʁɡən fɛʁˈʃiːbə nɪçt aʊ̯f ˈmɔʁɡən/
s: alternative form of was du heute kannst besorgen, das verschiebe nicht auf morgen
intensely, for all one is worth, as much as possible
Wir mussten ziehen, was das Zeug hält.
We had to pull for all we were worth.
Die Kinder toben herum, was das Zeug hält.
The children are jumping about like crazy.
was das Zeug hält.et: Literally, “what[ever] the gear endures”. Likely referring to sails (Zeug meaning “fabric”), harnesses (cf. Zaumzeug), or the like.
